title: TimelineSegment
description: One line of vault/<date>/timeline.jsonl: a stretch of the review day (04:00 to 04:00 local) spent in one place doing one kind of thing. Time the computer and phone did not record has no segment.

category.description: At the desk only: coding, studying, ... or other.

talk.description: Moment ids of conversations recorded during the segment.

switches.description: Times something else was in front for under 20 s and the segment went on.

evidence.description: Ids of the records the segment was made from: capture:app:<id>, capture:visit:<id>, capture:away:<id>, capture:media:<id>, place:<id>, event ids.

fidelity.description: illustrative: made from synthetic or sample records.

labeled.description: How the category was decided; null away from the desk.

key.description: At the desk: the window or page in front longest (page:<url> or app:<program>|<title>), the key a correction of just it uses.

broad.description: Its site or app (site:<domain> or app:<program>), the key a correction of all of it uses.
